sentences.zh: 在关键问题上仍存在严重分歧，例如关于化石燃料的史无前例的措辞，以及发达国家应为适应气候危机贡献多少资金。

sentences.en: Deep divisions remained on key issues like unprecedented language on fossil fuels and how much money developed countries should contribute to adapt to the climate crisis.
sentences.zh: 我想提醒大家，我们还有98个月的时间将全球排放量减半。

sentences.en: I would like to remind us all that we have 98 months to halve global emissions.
sentences.zh: 1.5度和2度之间的差异就是死刑判决。

sentences.en: The difference between 1.5 and 2 degrees is a death sentence.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收看节目的美国及世界各地的观众。

sentences.en: Welcome to our viewers in the United States and around the world.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月2日星期二，美国人正在这个选举日前往投票站投票。

sentences.en: It is Tuesday, November 2nd, and Americans are heading to the polls on this election day.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，所有人的目光都集中在两场关键的州长竞选上。

sentences.en: And this morning, all eyes are on two critical races for governor.
sentences.zh: 在弗吉尼亚州，还有新泽西州，两个州的投票站都在一小时前开放了。

sentences.en: In Virginia, also in New Jersey, polls opening one hour ago in both states.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的24小时内，我们可能会提前看到明年中期选举及以后的情况。

sentences.en: And in the next 24 hours, we could get a preview of what next year's midterms will look like and beyond.
sentences.zh: NBC新闻刚刚宣布民主党人菲尔·墨菲赢得了新泽西州州长竞选。

sentences.en: NBC News has just called the New Jersey governor's race for Democrat Phil Murphy.
sentences.zh: 感谢你们对我们团队的信任。

sentences.en: Thank you for putting your trust in our team.
sentences.zh: 感谢你们对我们团队的信任。

sentences.en: All righty, Virginia, we won this thing!
sentences.zh: 好了，弗吉尼亚州，我们赢了！

sentences.en: ABC News projecting Republican Glenn Youngkin has won.
sentences.zh: 美国广播公司新闻部预测共和党人格伦·杨金获胜。

sentences.en: So when I looked at the results, especially in Virginia yesterday,
sentences.zh: 所以当我看到选举结果时，尤其是昨天弗吉尼亚州的结果，

sentences.en: I'm not so sure that it's that the Republicans won as much as that the Democrats loSt.
sentences.zh: 我不确定这是否是因为共和党人赢了，还是因为民主党人输了。

sentences.en: It was a disappointing night for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 这对民主党人来说是一个令人失望的夜晚。

sentences.en: Of course, they lost in Virginia and it was incredibly close in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们在弗吉尼亚州输了，而且在新泽西州的选情也极其胶着。

sentences.en: Those are two states that President Biden won by double digits.
sentences.zh: 这两个州都是拜登总统以两位数优势获胜的州。

sentences.en: One of the big issues for this governor's race has been just issues surrounding school.
sentences.zh: 这次州长竞选的一个重大议题就是围绕学校的问题。

sentences.en: What's going on here?
sentences.zh: 这里到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: Republicans out of power are seizing on schools as the place to stir up racial tension and culture wars.
sentences.zh: 失去权力的共和党人正抓住学校问题，将其作为煽动种族紧张和文化战争的阵地。

sentences.en: What you saw in Glenn Youngkin is going to be, for sure, the playbook that Republicans are going to try to emulate.
sentences.zh: 你在格伦·杨金身上看到的，肯定会成为共和党人试图效仿的策略手册。

sentences.en: Basically, this conservatorship is doing me way more harm than good.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这种监护权对我造成的伤害远大于益处。

sentences.en: Britney Spears has been faced with a decade-long nightmare.
sentences.zh: 布兰妮·斯皮尔斯面临着长达十年的噩梦。

sentences.en: The whole thing shocked me that she had been forced to take lithium, that she was forced to keep it in IUD, wasn't able to get married or have kids.
sentences.zh: 整件事让我感到震惊，她被迫服用锂盐，被迫放置宫内节育器，不能结婚或生孩子。

sentences.en: I just want my life back and it's been 13 years and it's enough.
sentences.zh: 我只想找回我的生活，已经13年了，受够了。

sentences.en: Free Britney now!
sentences.zh: 现在就还布兰妮自由！

sentences.en: Free Britney now!
sentences.zh: 现在就还布兰妮自由！

sentences.en: As official, the conservatorship of Britney Spears has been terminated.
sentences.zh: 正式宣布，布兰妮·斯皮尔斯的监护权已被终止。

sentences.en: What's next for Britney is up to one person.
sentences.zh: 布兰妮的下一步取决于一个人。

sentences.en: Britney.
sentences.zh: 布兰妮。

sentences.en: So I'm just grateful, honestly, for each day and being able to be independent and feel like a woman.
sentences.zh: 所以老实说，我很感激每一天，能够独立并感觉自己像个女人。

sentences.en: And it makes a huge difference.
sentences.zh: 这带来了巨大的改变。

sentences.en: Good day.
sentences.zh: 祝你今天愉快。

sentences.en: We're coming on the air with breaking news.
sentences.zh: 我们正在播报突发新闻。

sentences.en: A verdict has been reached in the trial of...
sentences.zh: 审判已达成裁决……

sentences.en: Kyle Rittenhouse.
sentences.zh: 凯尔·里滕豪斯案。

sentences.en: The 18-year-old is facing charges for killing two people and injuring another during a protest last year in Kenosha, Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 这位18岁的年轻人因去年在威斯康星州基诺沙的抗议活动中杀害两人并致伤一人而面临指控。

sentences.en: All right, members of the jury, have you elected a four-person?
sentences.zh: 好了，陪审团成员，你们选出陪审团主席了吗？

sentences.en: We, the jury, find the defendant, Kyle H.
sentences.zh: 我们陪审团裁定被告凯尔·H·

sentences.en: Rittenhouse, not guilty.
sentences.zh: 里滕豪斯，无罪。

sentences.en: As to the second count of the information...
sentences.zh: 关于起诉书的第二项指控……

sentences.en: This case is over.
sentences.zh: 此案结束。

sentences.en: Kyle Rittenhouse found not guilty on all five counts he faced in the shooting deaths of two men.
sentences.zh: 凯尔·里滕豪斯被判在两名男子枪杀案中面临的全部五项指控均不成立。

sentences.en: All right, let's switch you guys a little bit and talk about the Ahmaud Arbery trial.
sentences.zh: 好了，让我们转换一下话题，谈谈阿莫德·阿伯里案的审判。

sentences.en: In the Superior Court of Glynn County, state of Georgia, the state of Georgia versus Travis McMichael,
sentences.zh: 在佐治亚州格林县高等法院，佐治亚州诉特拉维斯·麦克迈克尔案，
zh_words: 诉特拉维斯·麦克迈克尔案

sentences.en: count one, malice murder.
sentences.zh: 第一项指控，蓄意谋杀。

sentences.en: We, the jury, find the defendant, Travis McMichael, guilty.
sentences.zh: 我们陪审团裁定被告特拉维斯·麦克迈克尔，有罪。

sentences.en: Twelve jurors found that all three defendants were guilty of the murder of Ahmaud Arbery, a black jogger who they chased in two pickup trucks and then shot dead.
sentences.zh: 十二名陪审员认定三名被告均犯有谋杀阿莫德·阿伯里的罪行，阿伯里是一名黑人慢跑者，他们开着两辆皮卡车追赶他，然后将他枪杀。

sentences.en: Even though Rittenhouse claimed he fired in self-defense and the three defendants in Georgia made the same claim, the jury takeaway in each case was far different.
sentences.zh: 尽管里滕豪斯声称他是出于自卫开枪，而佐治亚州的三名被告也提出了同样的说法，但陪审团在每起案件中的结论却大相径庭。

sentences.en: Well, the signature piece of President Biden's legislative agenda, the sweeping $2 trillion spending bill, is now on life support.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统立法议程的标志性项目，那项规模达2万亿美元的全面支出法案，现在已命悬一线。

sentences.en: I cannot vote to continue with this piece of legislation.
sentences.zh: 我无法投票支持继续推进这项立法。

sentences.en: I just can't.
sentences.zh: 我实在做不到。

sentences.en: This is a no.
sentences.zh: 我投反对票。

sentences.en: A live look at Capitol Hill this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上国会山的现场画面。

sentences.en: Senator Joe Manchin says he is against President Biden's signature legislation, known as the Build Back Better bill.
sentences.zh: 乔·曼钦参议员表示他反对拜登总统的标志性立法，即所谓的“重建美好”法案。

sentences.en: So what now?
sentences.zh: 那么现在怎么办？

sentences.en: What happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: Just this morning, the Senate Majority Leader announced that the Senate will still vote on this bill when they get back to Washington in early January,
sentences.zh: 就在今天早上，参议院多数党领袖宣布，参议院在明年一月初回到华盛顿时仍将对该法案进行投票，

sentences.en: vowing to put every member on the record on the Senate floor.
sentences.zh: 并誓言要让每一位议员在参议院会议厅记录在案。

sentences.en: And he said, not just on television.
sentences.zh: 他说，不仅仅是在电视上说说而已。

sentences.en: Day 331 of the Biden administration.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府执政第331天。

sentences.en: And with just nine days until Christmas, we are back, waiting in long lines for COVID tests.
sentences.zh: 距离圣诞节仅剩九天，我们又回到了排长队等待新冠检测的日子。

sentences.en: The nation now facing an alarming new surge in cases just as we head into year three.
sentences.zh: 随着我们进入第三个年头，全国现在面临着令人担忧的新一波病例激增。

sentences.en: I'm going to say that again, year three of this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我要再说一遍，这场大流行的第三年。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Omicron now officially here in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，奥密克戎毒株现在已正式进入美国。

sentences.en: We are in for a world of trouble, I'm afraid, in the next month or two.
sentences.zh: 恐怕在未来一两个月内，我们将陷入巨大的麻烦之中。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: is now averaging about 121,000 new COVID cases each day.
sentences.zh: 目前平均每天新增约12.1万例新冠病例。

sentences.en: You're dealing with a very transmissible virus.
sentences.zh: 你正在应对一种传染性极强的病毒。

sentences.en: We're looking over our shoulder at Omicron, and we have Delta staring us right in the face.
sentences.zh: 我们正提防着奥密克戎，而德尔塔毒株正直接摆在我们面前。

sentences.en: A lot of people are saying that it feels like March 2020 all over again.
sentences.zh: 很多人说感觉就像回到了2020年3月。

sentences.en: But people, please have some optimism.
sentences.zh: 但各位，请保持乐观。

sentences.en: Things are much better now than they were back then.
sentences.zh: 现在的情况比那时好多了。

sentences.en: I think 2022 is going to be a much better year than people are expecting.
sentences.zh: 我认为2022年将会比人们预期的要好得多。

sentences.en: Hopefully, we'll get better in 2022.
sentences.zh: 希望我们在2022年能好起来。

sentences.en: I hope it gets better in 2022.
sentences.zh: 我希望2022年情况会好转。

sentences.en: Happy New Year.
sentences.zh: 新年快乐。

sentences.en: Let's hope 2022 is a better year for all of us.
sentences.zh: 让我们希望2022年对我们所有人来说都是更好的一年。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for joining.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢收听。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由克莱尔·坦内斯凯特和悉尼·哈珀制作，埃里克·克鲁普克提供了帮助。

sentences.zh: 由拉里萨·安德森和丽莎·周编辑。

sentences.zh: 从下周开始，《每日新闻》将回顾我们今年最喜欢的剧集，重温并了解自它们首次播出以来发生了什么变化。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要完全黑暗的睡眠环境吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
